summary.text: Brooke Green represents Idaho House District 18, Seat B, and lives in Boise; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a fourth term.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography says Green was raised in Los Alamos, New Mexico, and has a master's degree in business administration from Northwest Nazarene University and degrees in communication and marketing technology from Boise State University.
The biography lists Green's occupation as associate transportation planner with Kittelson & Associates.
